entries.name: TotalSegmentator CT dataset (version 3, with version 2)
entries.what: CT scans of 1,939 patients (version 3) with 117 anatomical structures outlined: the training data of the TotalSegmentator model.
entries.usage: CT cases and their structure outlines are used as cases and as the reference for the anatomy layer, including the heart. Version 2 (1,228 scans) is the earlier release.
entries.citation: Wasserthal J, Breit HC, Meyer MT, et al. TotalSegmentator: robust segmentation of 104 anatomic structures in CT images. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence. 2023;5(5):e230024. doi:10.1148/ryai.230024. Data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.22688904 (v3) and doi:10.5281/zenodo.10047292 (v2).

entries.name: GOUHFI 2.0
entries.what: A brain segmentation model that works across MRI contrasts and resolutions.
entries.usage: Outlines brain structures and cortical regions on MRI; marked as AI drafts.
entries.citation: Fortin et al. GOUHFI 2.0. arXiv:2601.09006. Code and weights: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.17920473

entries.name: MONAI model zoo: wholeBody_ct_segmentation
entries.what: A pretrained whole-body CT segmentation model (SegResNet), trained on the TotalSegmentator dataset.
entries.usage: Outlines the four heart chambers and the heart muscle on contrast-enhanced CT; each outline is marked as an AI draft.
entries.citation: MONAI model zoo, bundle wholeBody_ct_segmentation v0.1.9. Trained on the TotalSegmentator dataset (Wasserthal J, et al., Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2023).

entries.name: nnU-Net
entries.what: The self-configuring segmentation framework that TotalSegmentator and the brain and Circle of Willis models run on.
entries.usage: Runs the segmentation models behind the AI outlines.
entries.owner: Division of Medical Image Computing, German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ)
entries.citation: Isensee F, Jaeger PF, Kohl SAA, Petersen J, Maier-Hein KH. nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation. Nature Methods. 2021;18:203-211. doi:10.1038/s41592-020-01008-z

entries.name: TopCoW 2024 challenge winning model (team CLAIM)
entries.what: A model that labels the arteries of the Circle of Willis on brain MRA.
entries.usage: Draws the AI outlines of the Circle of Willis arteries on brain MRA; marked as AI drafts.
entries.owner: Team CLAIM, Charite Berlin, and the TopCoW challenge organisers
entries.license: Trained on TopCoW data; see the TopCoW terms. The nnU-Net code is Apache-2.0.
entries.citation: Yang K, et al. Benchmarking the CoW with the TopCoW challenge. arXiv:2312.17670.

entries.name: TorchXRayVision (ChestX-Det PSPNet)
entries.what: A library of chest X-ray models; its ChestX-Det model outlines 14 chest structures.
entries.usage: Draws the AI outlines of structures on chest radiographs; marked as AI drafts.
entries.license: Apache-2.0 for the library; for the model weights see the source page
entries.citation: Cohen JP, Viviano JD, Bertin P, et al. TorchXRayVision: a library of chest X-ray datasets and models. MIDL 2022.

entries.name: TotalSegmentator
entries.what: A segmentation tool for CT and MR that outlines anatomical structures automatically.
entries.usage: Draws the AI outlines of organs, vessels and bones in the anatomy layer and the heart chambers; the outlines are marked as AI drafts. The licensed heart tasks (heartchambers_highres, coronary_arteries) are used with the owners' permission.
entries.license: Apache-2.0 for the code and the open tasks; the heart tasks are licensed by the owner
entries.citation: Wasserthal J, Breit HC, Meyer MT, et al. TotalSegmentator: robust segmentation of 104 anatomic structures in CT images. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence. 2023;5(5):e230024. doi:10.1148/ryai.230024

entries.name: Horalix (horalix.com)
entries.what: A medical AI company in Sarajevo. It makes Radiology Monster and presents the datasets and their processing in this app.
entries.usage: Horalix prepared the cases and drew the AI outlines of the anatomy layer, each marked as an AI draft. The outlines are not reviewed by a radiologist and are never used for grading.
entries.license: AI outlines are drafts made for this app and are always marked as AI
entries.citation: Anatomy outlines: AI drafts by Horalix.com, not reviewed by a radiologist.
